entities.name: PMID:10743821
observations: In 19 adult dogs after anterior cruciate ligament transection, synovial-fluid proteoglycan concentration did not correlate with arthroscopic or postmortem chondropathy severity; the 16-week level did not predict 32-week cartilage damage. Clearance adjustment did not remedy the lack of association.

entities.name: Canine SF GAG result
observations: In a canine ACL-transection model, synovial-fluid proteoglycan concentration neither correlated with chondropathy severity nor predicted subsequent cartilage damage.
